facts.title: blistered peas-in-the-pod with lemon and salt
ingredients: 1 pound fresh English or sweet peas, still in their pods
Freshly ground black pepper or red pepper flakes
Finely grated zest and a few wedges of one lemon
1/2 cup crumbled ricotta salata or feta (optional)
facts.yield_text: 4 as a side; 8 as an appetizer
facts.author: Deb Perelman
